title: Decision
description: Frontmatter schema for files in 02 Decisions/. ADR-style, immutable after acceptance.

uid.description: ULID identifier. Unique across all vault entries.

date.description: ISO 8601 date the decision was made (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: Current status of the decision. Only 'accepted' decisions are binding.

deciders.description: GitHub handles of everyone who had decision authority.

supersedes.description: UID of an earlier decision this one replaces. Null if this is the first decision on the topic.
